SEC. 3534. DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE CONSULTATION.

    Section 566 of title 14, United States Code, is amended--
            (1) in subsection (b) by striking ``enter into'' and 
        inserting ``maintain''; and
            (2) by striking subsection (d).
